guidance.inspection: Reconstruct the complete operative protected-information definition, including incorporated definitions, preambles, alternatives, exclusions, and form conditions. For explicit identification, test the universal requirement: reasonable-understanding, nature, circumstances, or automatic-inclusion alternatives contradict it; silence is NotMentioned. Express nontechnical subjects contradict technical-only scope. Express oral or verbal inclusion entails verbal coverage even if confirmation is required. Preserve every independently responsive definition and alternative.

operations.rationale: Retains the parent boundary while emphasizing universal quantifiers, indirect definitional chains, and complete evidence membership; one shared full-context demonstration controls representation cost.

guidance.inspection: Locate an operative permission, exclusion, restriction, or reservation and verify actor, object, recipient class, purpose, polarity, and conditions. Keep independent development distinct from lawful third-party receipt. Sharing needs an operative disclosure or access rule plus incorporated class definitions; an exclusive employee-only rule contradicts nonemployee sharing. Limited use requires a use restriction, not purpose-limited copying or disclosure. No-licensing requires an express no-right, ownership, or reservation rule; access alone is unresolved.

operations.rationale: Repairs recurring substitutions between development and acquisition, access and licensing, and employee versus nonemployee permissions without adding unsupported vocabulary requirements.

guidance.inspection: Read each return, destruction, copying, retention, and survival clause with its trigger, lead-in, alternatives, exceptions, and cross-references. Return-or-destruction needs a mandatory disposition tied within the operative rule to termination or a comparable contractual end; a request-only duty remains NotMentioned. Copy permission must be affirmative; consent-dependent prohibition contradicts it. Post-disposition possession requires an express retention exception, while an unqualified all-material duty contradicts it. Survival requires an identified obligation continuing after an end event.

operations.rationale: Targets observed relation errors involving request-only return duties, consent-based copying prohibitions, and unqualified return obligations while preserving full trigger and exception evidence.

guidance.inspection: Inspect the complete document for four separate controls. Agreement confidentiality includes nondisclosure of the agreement, its existence or terms, or discussions or negotiations; a direct sentence is sufficient, while definition-based coverage also needs the secrecy duty. Compelled-disclosure notice needs legal or governmental compulsion linked to notice or consultation. Preserve all operative personnel and corpus-supervised proxy-solicitation restrictions with lead-ins and exceptions. Reverse engineering requires an operative reverse-engineering, decompilation, or disassembly prohibition; absence of a clause is only NotMentioned.

operations.rationale: Corrects missed direct agreement-confidentiality evidence and keeps notice, solicitation, and reverse-engineering tests distinct without treating retrieval absence as proof.
